heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 95–148, title I, Oct. 31, 1977, 91 Stat. 1232

notes.text: Section, act Aug. 2, 1955, ch. 491, § 108, 69 Stat. 438, related to an accounting for military assistance funds.
Effective Date of RepealPub. L. 95–148 provided that the repeal of this section is effective Oct. 1, 1977.
